title: 设计地铁系统
summary: 记录乘客进出站，并查询任意起终站路线的平均乘车时间。
insight: 用乘客 id 映射当前进站信息；出站时按起点终点组成路线键，累计总时间和次数，平均值为二者相除。
pitfalls: 同一乘客完成行程后可移除进站记录
总时间使用 long 防止累加溢出

solutions.title: 在途记录与路线聚合
solutions.idea: 分别维护乘客当前行程及路线历史统计。
steps: checkOut 取出进站记录，以 start#end 为键累加耗时与次数

code.java: class UndergroundSystem { private static class CheckIn{String station;int time;CheckIn(String station,int time){this.station=station;this.time=time;}}private final Map<Integer,CheckIn> active=new HashMap<>();private final Map<String,long[]> routes=new HashMap<>();public void checkIn(int id,String stationName,int t){active.put(id,new CheckIn(stationName,t));}public void checkOut(int id,String stationName,int t){CheckIn start=active.remove(id);long[] aggregate=routes.computeIfAbsent(start.station+"#"+stationName,key->new long[2]);aggregate[0]+=t-start.time;aggregate[1]++;}public double getAverageTime(String startStation,String endStation){long[] aggregate=routes.get(startStation+"#"+endStation);return (double)aggregate[0]/aggregate[1];} }
code.kotlin: class UndergroundSystem { private val active=mutableMapOf<Int,Pair<String,Int>>();private val routes=mutableMapOf<String,LongArray>();fun checkIn(id:Int,stationName:String,t:Int){active[id]=stationName to t};fun checkOut(id:Int,stationName:String,t:Int){val start=active.remove(id)!!;val aggregate=routes.getOrPut(start.first+"#"+stationName){LongArray(2)};aggregate[0]+=(t-start.second);aggregate[1]++};fun getAverageTime(startStation:String,endStation:String):Double{val aggregate=routes[startStation+"#"+endStation]!!;return aggregate[0].toDouble()/aggregate[1]}}
code.cpp: class UndergroundSystem { unordered_map<int,pair<string,int>> active;unordered_map<string,pair<long long,int>> routes;public:void checkIn(int id,string stationName,int t){active[id]={stationName,t};}void checkOut(int id,string stationName,int t){auto start=active[id];active.erase(id);auto& aggregate=routes[start.first+"#"+stationName];aggregate.first+=t-start.second;++aggregate.second;}double getAverageTime(string startStation,string endStation){auto aggregate=routes[startStation+"#"+endStation];return (double)aggregate.first/aggregate.second;} };
